whoFor: Companies, business names and incorporated trustees registered in Nigeria, including foreign-owned companies whose owners manage the business from abroad.

benefits.title: Good standing
benefits.text: Banks, investors and partners check your status on the public register.

benefits.title: Records that match
benefits.text: Your directors, shareholders and addresses read the same everywhere.

benefits.title: One person to ask
benefits.text: A named coordinator tracks every filing until the CAC responds.

whatYouReceive: The filed return or update, with the CAC acknowledgement
Updated statutory registers that match what was filed
A compliance calendar of your next filing dates
A short filing record: what was filed, when and by whom
whatYouProvide: Your CAC registration number (RC, BN or IT number)
Current directors, shareholders or trustees, and any changes since the last filing
Financial statements, where the return requires them
Your written authority for SCS to file on your behalf
doesNotInclude: A promise of when the CAC will process a filing, or of its decision
Tax returns, which sit under Tax registration and compliance
Audited accounts, which come from your accountant or auditor
